description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Order of Whiteclay, untapping the Plains.
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Wild Cantor, untapping the Plains.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {1}{W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
